visualAuthority.firstImpression: Bright, high-energy Japanese travel-magazine wedding cover; playful, dense, layered, tropical and immediately magazine-like rather than a generic wedding brochure.
visualAuthority.signatureMove: An enormous pink WEDDING title occupies the upper third while a large smiling two-person couple hero rises directly beneath it; a left teaser stack, postal/date ephemera, tropical/destination clusters and a bottom story hook create an authored cover silhouette.
visualAuthority.composition: Dominant title block across upper third, one large central/right people-led hero, narrow asymmetric Feature 1/2/3 column on the left, date-ticket ephemera at left-middle, destination art at upper-right/mid-right, and a separate bottom closing hook with postmark/page meta.
visualAuthority.antiCompressionRule: Do not summarize rings, flower clusters, route doodles, feature icons, postmarks and story micro accents into one generic sticker layer.
